notes: Adds a <style> or <link> in the main world of the page's current document and waits for it to apply; a CSP refusal fails with RefusedByPolicy and a failed load with ResourceFailed. It returns nothing rather than an ElementHandle: Strider has no element handles, and a locator finds the element.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.
